finalDirection: From US-2 at Coles Corner, turn north on SR 207 and go about 4.4 miles, turn right onto Chiwawa Loop Road, then take the second left onto Chiwawa River Road (Forest Road 6200). Follow it about 23 miles to the Trinity Trailhead; it turns to gravel at about 11 miles and the last stretch is very rough.
note: Both pages give the same drive; the fire closure on the page is of the trail, not the road, so none added.

finalDirection: From the Mountain Loop Highway near milepost 7, turn onto Tupso Pass Road (Forest Road 41). The road is washed out about 4.8 miles in and closed to vehicles beyond, so the trailhead at its end is reached only on foot or by bike.
note: Pages disagree on the stop (washout 4.8 mi vs Canyon Creek bridge ~8 mi from trailhead); text keeps the washout and closure, which both support.

finalDirection: From Glacier, drive east on SR 542 for about 12.5 miles to just past the highway maintenance facility and bear left onto Twin Lakes Road. Follow it about 7 miles to the parking between the two lakes; the road is rough and a high-clearance vehicle is needed beyond about 4.5 miles.
note: WTA gives 12.5 mi east of Glacier, Twin Lakes Road 7.0 mi, high clearance past 4.5 mi.

finalDirection: From SR 20 near milepost 82, turn north onto Baker Lake Road (Forest Road 11) and go about 14 miles, turn right onto Baker Dam Road and cross Upper Baker Dam, then turn left onto FR 1107 and follow it about 8.9 miles to the Anderson and Watson Lakes junction and 1.1 miles more to the trailhead. A washout has closed FR 1107 to vehicles since July 2026.
note: Drive matches both pages; closure alert dated 7.8.26 (FR 1107 closed at mile 3.8) and agency page says inaccessible due to washout.

finalDirection: From the Nisqually entrance of Mount Rainier National Park (SR 706), drive east on the Nisqually-Longmire Road for 1 mile and turn left onto Westside Road. Follow it 3.2 miles to the closed gate at Dry Creek and park short of the barricade.
note: Westside Road open now, park south of the Dry Creek barricade.
